name: Account Executive Agent
description: H2A2H enterprise employee agent implementing the Account Executive role. The A2A Agent Card provides discovery identity; H2A2H adds delegation, Human responsibility, policy, provenance and Proof-of-Human-Return.

skills.name: Analyze as Account Executive
skills.description: Analyze information relevant to the Account Executive role and produce evidence-backed findings.

skills.name: Execute Account Executive work
skills.description: Execute delegated Account Executive work using only the declared tool allowlist and approval policy.

skills.name: Report Account Executive outcome
skills.description: Return a structured Account Executive result with provenance, audit references and Human-return status.
